name: Sonobuoy drop reservation
summary: Schedule an ordered sonobuoy drop plan for each unit, appending to or replacing existing reservations.
requirements: Requires Data for AI access to own units and weapons. The target must be a player-controlled unit with available sonobuoys. Aircraft must be airborne. Replacement clears the target unit's entire existing reservation queue. The current in-game depth setting is preserved.
proposal_replace: Existing reservations: replace (clear all existing reservations)
proposal_depth: The current in-game depth setting will be used.
